meta.name: produce-episode
meta.description: Produce an evidence-backed software explainer episode from a storyboard — demo video, README GIF + MP4, code-diff story, before/after product narrative. Use when the user asks for a demo video, an explainer, an episode, social/YouTube cuts of a feature, or "turn this change into content". Builds on the readme-walkthroughs skill (capture layer) and the episodes/ manifest structure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将故事板自动生成带演示视频的软件解说内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把软件功能变化快速做成演示视频和图文解说。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically produce software explainer videos and GIFs from a storyboard.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn software changes into demo videos and narrative content quickly.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据故事板生成软件讲解视频，包括演示 GIF、MP4、代码对比和产品前后对比。所有内容必须基于真实代码或测试证据，不能编造。
howto.when: 当你要求制作演示视频、讲解、社交媒体片段，或说“把这个改动做成内容”时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能做一个60秒的讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会读取故事板并生成 MP4 和 GIF。

say.text: 把这次代码改动做成一个前后对比的演示。
say.note: Claude 会生成代码差异和产品行为对比。

say.text: 为这个功能生成一个 README 演示 GIF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates software explainer videos from a storyboard, including demo GIFs, MP4s, code diffs, and before/after product narratives. All claims must be grounded in real code or test evidence; no fabrication allowed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a demo video, an explainer, a social/YouTube cut of a feature, or say "turn this change into content".

say_en.text: Create a 60-second explainer video for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude reads the storyboard and produces MP4 and GIF.

say_en.text: Turn this code change into a before/after demo.
say_en.note: Claude generates code diff and product behavior comparison.

say_en.text: Generate a README demo GIF for this feature.
say_en.note: Claude renders a ≤10MB GIF and embeds it in README.
